scenario.name: restaurant-saas-multitenant
scenario.description: Tenant-modeled SaaS restaurant sample with Pizza House, Sushi Bar, and Vegan Bistro as isolated restaurant customers.

notes: This sample models tenant ownership explicitly through Tenant plus tenantRef references -- an app-level business concept.

Separately, the platform itself now enforces real authenticated-tenant isolation (tenant_id) on every generated CRUD row, on both the generic CRUD path and flow-driven persistence, and rejects a tenantRef bond pointing at another platform tenant's row.
CRUD population scripts use the generated REST API only; they do not write to the database directly.
Use 'dev,trial' (not 'dev,step0,trial') to boot against the real H2Local database in Input/db.definition.json -- step0 would override it with an ephemeral in-memory store.

demonstrate-platform-tenancy.ps1 walks through the platform admin surfaces: /api/admin/tenants (create/disable/enable), /api/admin/credentials (issue/revoke), and the resulting authenticated-tenant isolation.

StaffMember is overridden to persistence.adapter=tenant: the LIVE per-request adapter switch. PUT /api/admin/tenants/{tenantId}/persistence-mode toggles a SINGLE platform tenant into audited mode with no regenerate/reboot -- other tenants' StaffMember access is unaffected.
